storage_per_gb_month.same_in_both_classes: For charges, the Standard and Infrequent Access log classes differ in ingestion costs only. Storage charges and CloudWatch Logs Insights charges are the same in each log class.

insights_per_gb_scanned.quote: $0.005 per GB log data scanned by CloudWatch Logs Insights queries - US East (Northern Virginia)

s3_put_per_1000.quote: $0.005 per 1,000 PUT, COPY, POST, or LIST requests

put_log_events_overhead.quote: The maximum batch size is 1,048,576 bytes. This size is calculated as the sum of all event messages in UTF-8, plus 26 bytes for each log event.
put_log_events_overhead.billed: No sentence on the pricing page or the billing page says these bytes are billed; the billed usage type is DataProcessing-Bytes for PutLogEvents.
